@@ Camouflage
@stat: Em
@description:
  Descriptions This skill provides a bonus in hiding or concealing an another
  person by using the natural attributes of the surrounding environment.

@@ Disarming Traps
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus in identifying and disarming, not locating, an
  inanimate trap.

@@ Disguise
@stat: Pr
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus to change one’s appearance actual shape or
  weight) by application of cosmetics and props.

@@ Counterfeiting
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for creation of false but believable writings
  or illustrations or records from scratch. It is used falsify bank records
  and accounts, change testimony records misrepresent the facts, etc. Also
  includes the ability to simulate official documents, official currency
  (coined or paper moneys), stocks and bonds.

@@ Forgery
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus to replicate specific objects, of art, etc.
  Where counterfeiting is the skill of producing believable copy of
  something, forgery represents the ability reproduce a specific item. Note
  that this skill must be developed for a specific type of item, such as
  signatures, art, weapons,  Rolemaster Standard Rules 198

@@ Hiding Items
@stat: Re
@description:
  item or The skill provides a bonus to hide an item from other beings.

@@ Setting Traps
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for setting traps. Traps can be lethal or
  non-lethal. The traps used by this skill are either very simple snares or
  pre-built mechanisms that are set into place.  to

@@ Trap Building
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus to build complex mechanisms designed to injure
  or immobilize other creatures. Note that skill is the actual building of
  the mechanism, not the effective placement or setting of a trap.

@@ Using/Removing Poison
@stat: SD
@description:
  a This skill provides a bonus for handling, caring and storing to poisons.
  Allows individual to use poison without accidentally poisoning himself or
  rendering the poison useless.  etc.
